summary: The proposed patch addresses the minversion failures but introduces a regex-based version parsing, which may not cover all edge cases and could be considered a non-minimal change.

issues.description: The patch introduces a regex-based version parsing, which may not cover all edge cases and could be considered a non-minimal change.
The automated tests already pass, but additional tests should be added to ensure the regex-based version parsing works correctly for all possible inputs.
The patch uses a regex-based approach, which may not be consistent with the existing implementation using LooseVersion.
